Measured energy on the shared HVAC duty basis ranks P4 9 kWh, P3 20, P2 33, P1 50; the minimum is unique, so the ID tie-break is idle and the written policy selects P4. sections.body: On the single shared thermal load, operating period and acceptance basis, measured energy ranks P4 9 kWh, P3 20, P2 33, P1 50. Successive gaps are 11 kWh (P4 to P3), 13 kWh (P3 to P2) and 17 kWh (P2 to P1); the total spread is 41 kWh. The minimum is unique, so the lowest-ID tie-break never engages. Because every package faces the identical test basis, this ordering is a genuine efficiency result needing no normalization. The quality-energy association is positive: the two highest-quality packages, P3 (98) and P4 (100), are also the two lowest-energy, while P2 (82) is the quality minimum yet only mid-field on energy.
